title: Embedding Migration Operator
subtitle: Rebuilds the search vectors for a whole index or for all engineering notes, in bulk on a GPU or one item at a time on CPU.
lede: Rebuilds the search vectors for a whole index or for all engineering notes, in bulk on a GPU or one item at a time on CPU. It warns when the new model's size does not match the stored vectors and reports progress and exact counts throughout.
who: A platform lead changing the model that powers search, or rebuilding search after a failure
author: Corey James
